rationale: After briefly testing a new session high at $13.66, the stock suffered a sharp rejection on expanding selling volume, erasing a 1.30% unrealized gain and breaking back below both yesterday's high ($13.39) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($13.45). With the breakout thesis broken and price pressing directly down onto session VWAP ($13.37), exiting at market protects capital rather than waiting for the lower invalidation stop at $13.26 to be hit. A flip to short is avoided due to the strong broader market tailwinds (SPY +0.95%) and VWAP support directly below.
